about: Deux-Montagnes is a North Shore city in the Laurentides, on Lac des Deux Montagnes where the Ottawa River widens toward the St. Lawrence. EXO train service ends at the waterfront station, linking a lakeside downtown and suburban neighbourhoods to downtown Montréal. Parks and beaches face the lake and Rivière des Mille Îles. About 18,000 people live in Deux-Montagnes.
